The '''Pre-Lament Civilization''' (PLC) was Solaris' native civilisation before the destruction wrought by [[The Lament|the Lament]]. It was capable of spacetravel, having sent thousands of satellites and nine interstellar probes, including [[The Farwatcher]], into the darkness of space - these nine probes represented by the stars in the emblem of the [[Spacetrek Collective]]. The PLC's cities and machinery were powered by electricity; electric-powered devices, such as Jinzhou's Disruptor, are rarer in the present. The Lament destroyed 80% of their structures and killed half the global population.

The Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organisation, may have been a part of this civilisation and created the [[Resolution K626|plan]] which lead to the creation of [[The Black Shores|the Black Shores]] to safeguard humanity.

It may be related to the {{Lang|Hé civilisation|zh=禾文明}} discovered by researchers in [[Whining Aix's Mire]].
